uuid: Canonical lowercase non-nil RFC4122 UUID; no normalization

cas.observed_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; opaque declared snapshot, no database lookup

evidence_semantics: Only reference syntax and digest syntax are checked. Referenced bytes, external origin, identity, organizational authority and preservation are NOT verified.
receipt_semantics: Every state is an untrusted declaration, including RECONCILED_DECLARED. No payload can prove COMMIT. One immutable receipt per attempt_id within a bundle; a new observation uses a new attempt_id. No temporal order or live state is certified.

integrity.serialization: Python json.dumps of top-level object excluding ONLY digest; sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False; UTF-8; no newline
integrity.optional_fields: Absent remains absent; null, defaults and normalization forbidden; present declared_at is included in digest
integrity.declared_at: Optional YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ valid calendar time; declared, not trusted; no clock or expiration policy
integrity.self_reference: Intention never references receipt. Receipt binds already-computed intention digest. Each excludes only its own top-level digest.

input_paths: POSIX absolute input-root without symlinks; explicit relative .json files only, safe ASCII components, regular single-link files; no traversal, globs, implicit retrieval, FIFO/device/socket or symlink following
bundle_semantics: At least one intention; every receipt needs matching intention in same invocation. Exact duplicate declarations permitted; different content under same act_id or attempt_id rejected. No persistence or cross-invocation duplicate detection.
